headline: Integrating Slack with v0: Streamlining Team Collaboration

sources.claim: The v0 bot for Slack lets anyone on your team contribute to production by mentioning `@v0` in a Slack channel. v0 reads the conversation thread for context, writes the code changes, creates a branch, and opens a pull request -- all without leaving Slack.
To target a specific repository or branch, use structured syntax: `@v0 [repo=acme/dashboard] Add a chart to the analytics page` or `@v0 [repo=acme/dashboard branch=feature-x] Fix the broken tooltip`.
Access channel settings by using the command `@v0 settings` to configure default repository and branch for the channel.
Once v0 opens a pull request, Vercel generates a preview deployment on every commit pushed to that branch, allowing your team to view and QA changes directly in the browser.

headline: The <picture> Preload Trap: One Hero, Two Downloads

sources.claim: The <picture> element selects the first matching source, whereas independent responsive preloads have no first-match ordering. The article recommends avoiding explicit preload when the image is quickly discoverable in HTML.

Media attributes can make image preloads conditional on mutually exclusive viewport ranges. Preloading both AVIF and WebP can download both in browsers supporting both formats, even though only one is used.

Important hero images should not be lazy-loaded. Fetch priority should be used sparingly because prioritizing one resource deprioritizes others; preloading is useful for images otherwise discovered through JavaScript or CSS.
LCP optimization requires examining discovery, resource priority, loading duration and element render delay. Improving one part alone does not guarantee a meaningful improvement to LCP.

headline: HTTP QUERY: Better Read Semantics, Not Automatic Architecture Simplification

fetch fulfills with a Response when a server returns an HTTP error such as 404, so applications must check the response status.
Preflight responses use Access-Control-Allow-Origin, Access-Control-Allow-Methods and Access-Control-Allow-Headers to communicate permitted cross-origin access.
